title: Initial split-body configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $start$ be one of its states, and let $w$ be a Boolean input word. The initial configuration of the split-body machine on $w$ has the anchor state, its input head at position $1$, blank work tapes with all heads at position $0$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite Turing machine over Bool
start is a state of M
